title: The proper scalar mate respects site comparison and intrinsic realization
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, phi:A -> B a ring homomorphism, and g:Z -> Y a proper morphism between noetherian schemes. Let H and HB be bounded-below etale complexes over A and B and e:LS_phi(H) isomorphic to HB. Let C_T denote the canonical intrinsic site comparison, S_T intrinsic derived scalar extension, P_A and P_B intrinsic derived direct images, delta_T the canonical site/scalar isomorphism, and p_A:C_Y Rg_A(H) -> P_A C_Z(H), p_B:C_Y Rg_B(HB) -> P_B C_Z(HB) the canonical D+ direct-image mates transported by intrinsic realization. If alpha_g:S_Y P_A -> P_B S_Z is the scalar-adjunction transpose of P_A(eta_Z) followed by sfDerivedImageRestriction, then alpha_g at C_Z H followed by P_B(delta_Z followed by C_Z(e)) equals S_Y(p_A inverse), then delta_Y, then C_Y(scalarMate at H followed by Rg_B(e)), then p_B. The equation concerns only proper image and does not include any open extension or compactification.

proof.text: Use realizationScalar_directImage_mate at the fixed-scalar pro-etale comparison of H. This isolates the unbounded intrinsic-realization part of the argument, before any change of site.

Apply the proved etaleProEtale_scalar_mate to H. Its first lower bound is H.property; its second is transported from HB.property through eHB. Naturality of the ambient B-comparison inserts the arbitrary eHB.

Identify each properSiteIso with the ambient site mate by properSiteIso_hom_ambient. Expand the definition of siteScalarIso and use naturality of the site, realization-scalar, and direct-image-realization isomorphisms. Cancel their inverse pairs and substitute the two preceding equations.

theorem properScalar_transport
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper g]
    [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (H : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))))
    (HB : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B))))
    (eHB : (Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) Z).obj H.obj ≅
      HB.obj) :
    ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Y)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).map
            ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Z)).unit.app
              ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).obj H.obj)) ≫
          (sfDerivedImageRestriction g φ).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ Z)).obj
              ((ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).obj H.obj))) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g B).map
        ((siteScalarIso φ Z).hom.app H.obj ≫
          (ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z B).map eHB.hom) =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ Y)).map (properSiteIso A g H).inv ≫
      (siteScalarIso φ Y).hom.app
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          H.obj) ≫
      (ProEtale.finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y B).map
        ((Etale.scalarMate (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) g).app H.obj ≫
          (Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.map
            eHB.hom) ≫
      (properSiteIso B g HB).hom
